method_note: V9: recalibrated per-park weather model on NWS temp/wind/dew/precip, with BallparkPal barometric pressure fed in as the air-density input and the published number weighted 0% toward BP's weather-only runs on games BP covers (v8.run_adj_pct = blended; v8.model_pct = pure model; v8.bp_pct = BP). Uncovered games are pure model. Retractable roofs treated as outdoor when the roof-schedule page marks the date Open. When the roof state is unknown, closed is assumed (headline 0) and a pure-model open-roof adjustment is emitted under open_v8 for a dual 'closed 0 · open +X%' display.
